children.text: Lindsay Nikole is a zoologist who has experience working with several wildlife and animal sanctuaries, as well as a B.S. in Zoology from Oregon State University. Her content focuses on zoology, paleontology, and evolution. Nikole produces content on several platforms, including YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Patreon. Across all of these platforms, Nikole balances a conversational and humorous tone with well-researched and, at-times, dense scientific material. In this, she creates “edutainment.” Her teaching method is bolstered by her comedy and irreverence, making potentially intimidating natural science accessible. The description of an influencer fits Nikole, but many may characterize her as a science communicator. Her content has a distinct internet style, seen in her profanity, memes, slang, and often-exaggerated reactions, while still being informative. Her intended audience is a diverse crowd, from PhD zoologists to people with little formal science education, and Nikole attempts to make them laugh so hard they do not realize they are learning until it is too late. Nikole persuades this broad audience by combining scientific credibility with humor and internet imagery, making specialized knowledge feel accessible.
